115
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 30, 2011/Bhadra 8, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and Forests;
Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public
Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Rural Development)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Cases of child deaths in hospitals
†*381. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
deaths of children have been reported from
hospitals in the country recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of children died in a hospital in
Kolkata between 2002 and 2006;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether it is also a fact that recently
a number of children died during 24 hours
in the same hospital; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Cases of violation of Benami
Transactions (Prohibition)
Act, 1988
*382. SHRI SHANTA KUMAR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of cases of violation of
Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act,
1988 registered during the last three years
in the country; and
(b) the details of action taken against
the defaulters under the Act, State-wise?
Criteria for opening of new medical
colleges
*383. SHRI RAM KRIPAL YADA V:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria and requirement of land
for opening of new medical colleges;
(b) whether there are different criteria
for the private institutions and Government
institutions;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to modify the criteria and make it
mandatory for all new medical colleges not
to come up on agricultural land anywhere
in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

116
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Disclosure of earnings by BCCI and
IPL
*384. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that BCCI and
IPL have disclosed very low earnings to
avoid paying taxes;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps Government is taking in
this regard?
Status of PMGSY and NRRDA
*385. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the present status and actual
outcome of the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak
Yojana (PMGSY) and the National Rural
Road Development Agency (NRRDA) in
the years 2009-10 and 2010-11;
(b) whether the funds amounting to
Rs. 18,500 crore, allocated for the Yojana,
have been duly utilised; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of recommendations
of the Vaidyanathan Committee
†*386. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Vaidyanathan
Committee-I was constituted for revival of
short-term co-operative loan structure and
it has submitted its recommendations;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Vaidyanathan
Committee-II has submitted its
recommendations for revival of long-term
co-operative loan structure as well;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the action taken by Government so
far on the recommendations of the
Vaidyanathan Committee-II; and
(f) whether Government would consider
implementing these recommendations and
if so, by when?
High Infant Mortality Rate in Andhra
Pradesh
*387. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in Asifabad
area of Adilabad district in Andhra Pradesh,
the Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) is 183
out of 1000, whereas the national average
is 50 only;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to stop such deaths in future
and the action plan to handle the situation?
White Paper on black money
*388. SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to refer to the reply to Starred Question 27
given in the Rajya Sabha on 2nd August,
2011 and state:
(a) whether Government has set up a
Committee headed by the Chairman,
Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) to
examine ways to strengthen laws to curb
generation of black money, its transfer to
overseas banks and how to bring back illicit
money of $ 462 billion, i.e. Rs. 20,79,000
crore, as worked out by the Global
Financial Integrity Group; and

117
(b) whether Government propose to
publish a White Paper on black money and
if so, by when?
Introduction of PPF and Senior
Citizen Savings Schemes in
Andhra Bank
*389. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to refer to the reply
to Unstarred Question 2053  given in the
Rajya Sabha on 15th March, 2011 and
state:
(a) whether Government has received
response from the organisations to which
the case of introduction of Public Provident
Fund (P.P.F.)  Scheme, 1968 and Senior
Citizens Savings Scheme, 2004 in Andhra
Bank was referred;
(b) if so, whether Government has since
taken a decision in the matter; and
(c) if not, the details thereof indicating
the dates when Andhra Bank will introduce
these two Schemes?
Increase in NPAs of SBI
*390. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether provisions made for Non-
Performing Assets (NPAs) in the State Bank
of India (SBI) have increased from Rs. 2474
crore in 2008-09 to Rs. 8792 crore in
2010-11;
(b) if so, the sectors where the bad loans
have increased during these years; and
(c) the names of the companies/
individuals having outstanding loan of more
than Rs. 100 crore with SBI?
Modernization of Hindustan Paper
Corporation Ltd., Assam
*391. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of  HEA VY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
appointment of permanent Chairman-cum-
Managing Director of Hindustan Paper
Corporation Ltd. (HPCL) is delayed
inspite of having clear guidelines of the
Department of Public Enterprises in this
regard;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the corrective measures
undertaken to prevent HPCL from financial
deterioration;
(d) whether modernization and
technical upgradation of the said paper mill
have been carried out within the targeted
dates; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
HIV vaccine development
programme
*392. SHRI T.M. SELV AGANAPATHI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had launched a Rs. 50.00 crore HIV vaccine
development programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in India
every day around 7100 people are getting
infected with HIV; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

118
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Deaths due to consumption of tobacco
products
†*393. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons died due to
Gutka, Bidi, Cigarette and other types of
tobacco products during the last three
years; year-wise;
(b) the details of amount spent on
programmes being run for prohibition of
different types of tobacco products by
Government during the last three years,
year-wise;
(c) the details of amount received as tax
from sale of different types of tobacco
products during the last three years; and
(d) the details regarding the steps taken
for de-addiction from smoking?
Funds provided to Rajasthan under
JSY
†*394. SHRI ASHK ALI TAK: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds provided by the
Central Government to Rajasthan under the
Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) during the
last two years; and
(b) the number of women in the State
benefited by this scheme?
Child Care Leave for PSUs/Banks
employees
*395. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the provision for Child Care
Leave has been introduced in all
Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Nationalized
Banks under Ministries/Departments of the
Central Government;
(b) if so, the number of employees of
PSUs/Nationalized Banks who have availed
this facility since introduction of the
scheme;
(c) if not, what are the reasons for not
implementing this scheme in PSUs/
Nationalized Banks, as enjoyed by the
Central Government women employees;
and
(d) the time-frame  for extending the
provision of Child Care Leave to the
employees of the Nationalized Banks?
Failure of Anaemia Control
Programme
*396. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in comparison
to our neighbouring countries the problem
of anaemia is very acute in our country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that India
has had an Anaemia Control Programme
since the 1970s;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the reasons for the failure of the
Programme; and
(f) the details of further action proposed
to be taken to control anaemia, particularly
among women and children?
Cess on polluting energy sources
*397. SHRIMATI VASANTHI
STANLEY: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal with

119
Government to introduce cess on polluting
energy sources to cross-subsidize
alternative energy initiatives;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government can also avail
of funds pledged by high polluting
developed nations for the purpose of
developing clean energy sources; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Post retirement DA relief for NPS
beneficiaries
*398. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether under the New Pension
System (NPS) the employees will be
eligible for DA relief after retirement on
line of present pensioners under the earlier
scheme;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is not desirable on part of
Government to revise the pension of
employees under NPS in view of the ever-
present inflationary trends; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
Drinking water facilities for villages
*399. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
DRINKING WATER AND
SANITATION be pleased to state:
(a) how many villages in the country, as
on date, do not have drinking water
facilities;
(b) what was the financial outlay
provided by the Planning Commission in
the Eleventh Five Year Plan and how much
of that amount has been actually spent;
and
(c) how many villages have been
provided with the drinking water facilities
during the first four years of the Eleventh
Five Year Plan?
Reforms in the implementation of
schemes for rural upliftment
*400. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has been
carrying out reforms in the implementation
of various schemes devised for rural
upliftment; and
(b) if so, the details of  basic reforms to
be undertaken in the foreseeable future?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 24th August, 2011 Secretary-General.
Bhadra 2, 1933 (Saka)

120
I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Drinking Water and Sanitation : 399,
Environment and Forests : 397,
Finance : 382, 384, 386, 388, 389, 390, 395, 398,
Health and Family Welfare : 381, 383, 387, 392, 393, 394, 396,
Heavy Industries and Public
Enterprises : 391,
Petroleum and Natural Gas :—
Rural Development : 385, 400.
MGIPMRND—1387RS—24-08-2011.
